Nālaṃ kassaci tāṇāya, nālamassāsanāya ca;Avisāsaniyāvassaṃ, kitavā mārakiṃkarā.
Sattānamupaghātāya, madhurākāranimmitā;Rakkhasī viya santāna-māvisanti manoharā.
Mamaṃkārena vuḍḍhantā, ghoramāsīvisaṃ yathā;Vissaṭṭhā bhogadhammesu, assādenti aviddasu.
Sīghavāhī mahoghoyaṃ, klesavaṭṭaṃ mahabbhayo;Sakaṇṭakañca gahanaṃ, paṅkova duratikkamo.
Jālaṃva vitthataṃ loke,Mārapāso samoḍḍito;Pañjaraṃ cārako ceso,Sattānamanayāvaho.
Yatthānurāgasambaddhā, paliguṇṭhitasāyino;Makkaṭālepabaddhāva, nitthunanti vighātino.
Mīnakā vaṅkagiddhāva, ye gilitvā puthujjanā;Ghoraṃ maccumukhaṃ patvā, socantāpāyabhāgino.
Pāpakkhettamidaṃ ṭhānaṃ, micchālobhanisevanaṃ;Duccarītaṅkurārohaṃ, apāyaphalapūraṇaṃ.
Avajjaṃ natthi etesa-makattabbaṃ na vijjati;Sammuṭṭhasaccatā tesu, na patiṭṭhāti sādhutā.
Mahāsaṅkaṭupabyuḷhā, palibodhaparipphuṭā;Haññanti dukkhadhammehi, kāme bālā bhavepare.
Gāmasūkarapotāva, kāmāsucipariplutā;Camarīkatakammantā, asmiṃ loke palobhitā.
Khajjamānā kilesehi, kimīhiva nirantaraṃ;Parihāniṃ panaññāya, parivārenti mucchitā.
Paraṃ pamādābhivaṭṭhā, pāpaklesamahodakā;Tato taṇhānadī pūrā, pāpetāpāyasāgaraṃ.
Idhalokapariccattā, paralokatthadhaṃsitā;Gaṅgākuṇapakākāva, senti sokaparāyaṇā.
Iti sādīnavā kāmā, ghorā sālasilūpamā;Yattha bālā visīdanti, natthi saṅgo vijānataṃ.
Puññakkhettamidaṃ ṭhānaṃ, tapokammanisevanaṃ;Saddhāsīlaṅkurārohaṃ, sampattiphalapūraṇaṃ.
Saṅgapaṅkasamuttāro, ganthānaṃ viniveṭhanaṃ;Taṇhādāsabyanitthāro, seribhāvo sukhāvaho.
Vaṇṇakittisugandhāya, guṇamālā suganthitā;Pāpakopīnavasanaṃ, hirottappavicittitaṃ.
Accantaparisuddho ca, saddhammaratanāvali;Ariyānamalaṅkāro, anupāyi siriṅkaro.
Sabbākāravaropeta-metaṃ nekkhammasammataṃ;Sīlagambhīraparikkhaṃ, dhutaṅgoditatoraṇaṃ.
Samādhivīthivitthinnaṃ, satipākāragopuraṃ;Saddhāsamiddhisamphullaṃ, paññāpāsādasobhitaṃ.
Sammājīvadhajaṃ rammaṃ, hirottappapaṭicchadaṃ;Vimuttāmatasambhogaṃ, veneyyajanasevitaṃ.
Ayasānaṃ padaṭṭhānaṃ, guṇatejavināsanaṃ;Sabbasampattidahanaṃ, caturāpāyasādhakaṃ.
Apāyadukkhamāruḷhaṃ, ahitāvahitaṃ padaṃ;Sabbānatthakaraṃ ghoraṃ, sabbadukkhavidhāyakaṃ.
Tepi vāsenti dummedhā, nissaṅkā mohapārutā;Antomanasi ucchaṅke, ghoramāsīvisaṃ yathā.
Attano ca vināsāya, nissaṭaṃ klesapañjare;Cinantā nāvabujjhanti, vipattipathayāyino.
Mahagghasā bāhulikā, duppaññā kāyadaḷhikā;Ganthanīvaraṇābaddhā, icchālobhavasīkatā.
Dubbharatā ca dupposā, sukumārasukhālayā;Asantuṭṭhā mahicchā ca, loluppācāralakkhitā.
Siṅgāracapalācittā, pūtikāyānurāgino;Sīdantā palimāpannā, na viruḷhanti sāsane.
Kāmagiddhā durācārā, dussīlā mohapārutā;Khajjantā kaddamībhūtā, jinasāsanakaṇṭakā.
Khippamādittacelova, pāpapāvakamuṭṭhitaṃ;Bhāvanājalasekena, nibbāpeyya nirantaraṃ.
Sabhayaṃ viya kantāraṃ, ghoramāsīvisaṃ yathā;Papātamiva gambhīraṃ, miḷhaṃ viya ca paṇḍito.
Sorato sakhilo saṇho, mettāyanto dayāparo;Anāhaṭamano dhīro, santacitto khamāparo.
Ajjavācāracāritto, māyāsāṭheyyanissaṭo;Thambhasārambhanissaṅgo, maddavācārapesalo.
Cetokhilasamucchedī, vinibandhaviveṭhako;Mānasaṃ sampahaṃseti, saṃkilesavimuttiyā.
Sallekhavutti dhutavā, pāpāpacayatapparo;Pāsādikasamācāro, pasādabahulo muni.
Anuddhato acapalo,Danto gutto yatindriyo;Cetosamādhigaruko,Sampajāno satīyuto.
Pāpagāhavinimutto, rāhumuttova candimā;Guṇaraṃsiparikkhitto, sobheti jinasāsanaṃ.
Sassaggādimhi kammante, vāyokasiṇamaṇḍalaṃ;Paṭibhāgasamācāro, phuṭṭhaṭṭhāneva jāyati.
Vikkhepaṃ vinivārento, paripanthe virājayaṃ;Nimittābhimukheneva, mānasaṃ paṭipādaye.
Niggayha uddhataṃ cittaṃ, paggayha līnamānasaṃ;Ūhataṃ sampahaṃsento, upekkhanto samāhitaṃ.
Vitakkādikathūlaṅgaṃ, pahānāya yathākkamaṃ;Tatheva paṭipajjanto, pappoti dutiyādayo.
Vividhākārapāṇehi, khajjamānaṃ vikhāditaṃ;Vināsitaṅgapaccaṅgaṃ, vikkhittanti pavuccati.
Pādādibhaṅgavikkhittaṃ, hatavikkhittakaṃ mataṃ;Lohitaṃ lohitākiṇṇaṃ, puḷavaṃ kimisaṅkulaṃ.
Vināsamānassākāraṃ, tatthevaṃ pana passato;Vipassanābhāvanāti, tamīrenti tathāgatā.
Bahi maṭṭhamupaṭṭhāti, anto kuṇapapūritaṃ;Uggharantaṃ paggharantaṃ, navadvāramalassavaṃ.
Sarīraṃ niccaduggandhaṃ, nānākimisamākulaṃ;Tacamaṃsapaṭicchannaṃ, aṭṭhipañjarasaṇṭhitaṃ.
Susānagamanosānaṃ, bahusādhāraṇāsubhaṃ;Gaṇḍabhūtaṃ sallabhūtaṃ, bahudukkhanibandhanaṃ.
Tathāpi jālasantāno, bahusambhārasaṅkhato;Vatthālaṅkārasañchanno, mālāgandhādisobhito.
Saviññattivikārehi, vicittākāramaṇḍito;Kāyo līḷavilāsehi, palambheti mahājanaṃ.
Arahaṃ sugato loke, bhagavā lokapāragū;Vijjācaraṇasampanno, vimuttiparināyako.
Cakkhumā titthakusalo, dhammassāmī tathāgato;Maccudheyyavimokkhāya, paṭipādayi pāṇino.
Satthavāho mahāyoggo, maggāmaggayudhandharo;Sirisatthamadhiggayha, vicarittha mahāpathaṃ,
Atthabhūto dhammabhūto,Brahmabhūto mahāyaso;Ñāṇālokaparicchinna-Ñeyyāsesapariggaho.
Sabbā bhiññābalappatto, vesārajjavisārado;Sabbasampattiniṭṭhāno, guṇapāramipūrako.
Appameyyo mahānāgo, mahāvīro mahāmuni;Mahesī mahitācāro, mahāmaho mahiddhiko.
Byāmappabhāparikkhitto, ketumālāhalaṅkato;Dvattiṃsalakkhaṇāsītianubyañjanasobhito.
Chabbaṇṇaraṃsilalito, ratanagghiyasannibho;Samiddhirūpasobhaggo, dassaneyyaṃva piṇḍitaṃ.
Phullaṃ padumasaṇḍaṃva, kapparukkhovalaṅkato;Nabhaṃva tārakākiṇṇaṃ, uttamo paṭidissati.
Niddhotamalacandova, nakkhattaparivārito;Khattasaṅghaparibyuḷho, cakkavattīva sobhati.
Iccānantaguṇākiṇṇamasesamalanissaṭaṃ;Sabbasampattidātāraṃ, vipattivinibandhakaṃ.
Taṇhādaliddanāsāya, manorathasamiddhiyā;Kālantaramanāgamma, paccakkhaphaladāyako.
Avijjāpaṭaluddhāravijjānettosadhaṃ varaṃ;Paññādhāramidaṃ satthaṃ, klesagaṇḍappabhedakaṃ.
Satisārathisaṃyutto, sammādiṭṭhipurejavo;Esa dhammaratho yāti, yogakkhemassa pattiyā.
Palāpāpagato suddho, paṭipattipatiṭṭhito;Pariggahitasaddhammo, samiddhiguṇasobhito.
Sugatorasi sambhūto, sucidhammasirindharo;Paṭipāditasampatto, dhammasāsanasevito.
Ujumaggamadhiṭṭhāya, mārakāyappadālano;Aparājitasaṅgāmo, lalitodātavikkamo.
Nekākāravarūpeto, nānāsampattiphullito;Vipattipathanittiṇṇo, abhibuddhiparāyaṇo.
Āhuneyyo pāhuneyyo,Dakkhiṇeyyo sudullabho;Sadevakassa lokassa,Puññakkhettamanuttaraṃ.
Yaṃ phalaṃ paribhuñjantā, vimuttirasasevanaṃ;Accantasukhitā dhīrā, bhavanti ajarāmarā.
Evametesu yaṃ kiñci, samādāya rahogato;Tamānisaṃsaṃ guṇato, phalato ca vicintaye.
Klesapañjaravicchedi, vipattipathavāraṇaṃ;Sotthikammasamuṭṭhānaṃ, asādhāraṇamaṅgalaṃ.
‘‘Suladdhā vata me laddhā, saddhā sugatasāsane;Sīlaṃ me yassa kalyāṇaṃ, parisuddhamakhaṇḍi
‘‘Dullabho vata me laddho,Mahālābho anappako;Yohamakkhalitācāro,Upaghātavivajjito.
Itthaṃ nānappakārena, cintento guṇamattano;Sīlakkhandhassa bhāveti, sīlānussatibhāvanaṃ.
Saddhāya sīlavantesu, datvā dānaṃ yathārahaṃ;Niddhotamalamacchero, vivitto tamanussare.
Cetovikāradamanaṃ, micchāmagganivāraṇaṃ;Vittilābhasukhassādo, vibhavodayamaṅgalaṃ.
Dhammādhigatabhogānaṃ, sārādānamanuttaraṃ;Mahattādhigamūpāyaṃ, lokasantatikāraṇaṃ.
Ujumaddavacittosmi, kālussiyavinissaṭo;Pāpasaṃklesavimukho, pāṇabhūtānukampako.
‘‘Saṃsāraddhānapātheyyaṃ, sabbadukkhavinodanaṃ;Subandhaṃ mama sabbattha, gahito ca kaṭagga
Evaṃ dānaguṇaṃ nānappakārena vicintayaṃ;Bhāveti dāyakoyogī, cāgānussatibhāvanaṃ.
Susamāhitasaṅkappā, dānasīladhurandharā;Dhammamaggamadhiṭṭhāya, hirottappapurakkhatā.
Taṃ lokamupapannāse, sassirīkaṃ parāyaṇaṃ;Iddhimanto jutimanto, vaṇṇavanto yasassino.
Dibbasampattisampattā, nānābhogasamappitā;Pālento dīghamaddhānaṃ, anubhonti mahāsukhaṃ.
Saddhammaguṇasampatti-dātā maṅgalanāyikā;Dullabhāpi ca me laddhā, saddhā sugatasāsane.
Maccheramalanittiṇṇo, lobhakkhandhavimuccito;Opānabhūto lokasmiṃ, vissaṭṭhasukhayācano.
Vatthuttayamahatte ca, hitāhitavinicchaye;Paññā vatthusabhāve ca, tikhiṇā mama vattati.
Devatāhi samānohaṃ, guṇālaṅkārabhūsito;Hatthapattā ca deviddhi, nipphannā dibbasampadā.
Devasāmaññamiccevaṃ, cintento guṇamattano;Bhāveti guṇasampanno, devatānussatiṃ paraṃ.
Yamekarattiṃ paṭhamaṃ, gabbhe vasati mānavo;Abbhuṭṭhitova so yāti, sa gacchaṃ na nivattati
Sattā maranti gabbhepi, jāyamānā ca dārakā;Kumārā yobbanappattā, balappattā mahattarā.
Ajja suveti maraṇaṃ, pariyesati pāṇino;Senā yuddhapayātāva, sabbe maccubhayākulā.
Accantarāyabahulo, maraṇāhitasambhavo;Niccaṃ cakkasamāruḷho, lokoyaṃ parivattati.
Etthantare maraṇassa, vemajjhe mama vattato;Assāsepi avissaṭṭhe, jīvikā ce kathāva kā.
Atthamārabbha gacchanto, ādiccova nabhantare;Maraṇāyābhidhāvanto, vihāyāmi suve suve.
Kilomaṃ pihaka papphāsaṃ, antaṃ guṇamudariyaṃ;Matthaluṅgaṃ karīsañca, pittaṃ semhamathāpar
Pubbo ca lohitaṃ sedo,Medo assu vasātha vā;Kheḷo siṅghāṇikā ceva,Lasikā muttamiccapi.
Ghanabandhasubhākāra-vipallāsānusārinaṃ;Yathābhūtāvabodhāya, vibhattāva mahesinā.
Chandarāgasamūpetā, yattha muḷhā puthujjanā;Sevanti visamaṃ ghoraṃ, caturāpāyabhāgino.
Hitvā appaguṇe tattha, gaṇhaṃ suppaguṇaṃ budho;Appanaṃ paṭibhāgañca, pappotekekavatthusu.
Tameva pariyādāya, samathañca vipassanaṃ;Mahattavepullagataṃ, bhāveyya satimā kathaṃ.
Ānāpānaṃ pariggayha, pavivitto rahogato;Gaṇeyya paṭhamaṃ tāva, nisinno sukhamāsane.
Pañcannaṃ na ṭhapetabbaṃ, heṭṭhā na dasatopari;Netabbamanupubbena, gaṇetabbamakhaṇḍitaṃ.
Thūle te eva saṅkhāre, sametuṃ paribhāvayaṃ;Vutto ‘‘passambhayaṃ cittaṃ, saṅkhāraṃ sikkhat
Tamevābhippamodento, sappītikasamādhinā;‘‘Abhippamodayaṃ cittaṃ, sikkhatī’’ti pavuccati.
Vipassanāyaniccānu-gatattā hi visesato;Vipassanto aniccānu-passī sikkhati paṇḍito.
Itthañca gaṇanādīhi, bhāvetvā samathaṃ tato;Vipassanādhivacanaṃ, katvā sallakkhaṇaṃ puna.
Buddhaṃ dhammañca saṅghaṃ puthunanamahitaṃ suddhasīlaṃ sudānaṃ,Dhammaṭṭhā devatāyopasamath
Yasovaṇṇavisaṅkhāro, guṇamūlappabhañjako;Dukkhadhammasamodhāno, byasanopaddavākaro.
Sabbākārapaṭikkūlaṃ, sabbaviddesakāraṇaṃ;Vipattimukhamuppannaṃ, amittajanapatthitaṃ.
Sapattakaraṇaṃ ghoraṃ, sabbānatthavidhāyakaṃ;Bhayamantarato jātaṃ, taṃ jano nāvabujjhati.
Khuradhāraṃ lihantāva, gilantāva hutāsanaṃ;Tittalābuṃva khādantā, gaṇhantādittamāyudhaṃ.
Byāpādamattasambhava-mattaghaññāya kevalaṃ;Upalāḷenti dummedhā, ghoramāsīvisaṃ yathā.
Anāthā sallakāviddhā, visaṭṭā anusocino;Andhā viya migāraññe, bhamanti hatacakkhukā.
Codayamānā dukkhehi, klesāciṇṇamalīmahā;Pāpakammehi pūrentā, senti maccupathe ciraṃ.
Vaṇṇakittisamuṭṭhānaṃ, guṇamūlābhisevanaṃ;Apārutamukhaṃveta-matthadvayasamiddhiyā.
Vighātapariyādāna-māsavānamasesato;Paṭipassambhanaṃ ceto-pītikaraṇacandanaṃ.
Cetopasādasandhāno, pāsādikaphalāvaho;Pavaro bodhisambhāro, narānaranisevito.
Paññāsīlasamādhānaṃ, paṭipattivisodhano;Piyaṅkaro sommabhāvo, dullabho bahupatthito.
Titikkhāguṇasampanno, pāṇabhūtānukampako;Anākulitakammanto, sorato sakhilo suci.
Akkhobho adhivāsento,Sabbānatthe parissaye;Bhīmasaṅgāmāvacaro,Hatthināgova sobhati.
Saddhāpāmojjabahulā, dānasīlamahussavā;Guṇabhūsitasantānā, āyuṃ pālentanāmayaṃ.
Te tattha kaṭukaṃ ghoramanubhontā sakaṃ phalaṃ;Dukkhasūlasamāviddhā, bāhā paggayha kandare
Anāthamanayāpannaṃ, parihānibhayākulaṃ;Vātamaṇḍalikakkhittapakkhīva parivattati.
Devakāyā mahābhogā,Mahesakkhā yasassino;Accharāparivārehi,Paricārenti nandane.
Iti sammā pihāyanto, sukhādhigamasampadaṃ;Sattānamabhirocento, muditāya samaṃ pharaṃ.
Sabhāvabhūta lokassa,Lābhālābhaṃ yasāyasaṃ;Nindāpasaṃsaṃ passanto,Sukhaṃ dukkhañca kevalaṃ
Kathaṃ kammassakatattāyaṃ lokānuparivattati;Lokadhamme parābhūto, attādheyyavivajjito.
Tattha kāyavasenete, parivattanti aññathā;Yathārucitakammantā, paccekavasavattino.
Na liṅgavisabhāgamhi, ādikammikayoginā;Bhāvetabbā matasatte, mettameva na sabbathā.
Iccābhivuddhimicchanto, dukkhāpagamanaṃ tathā;Samiddhe anumodanto, upekkhanto ca pīṇite.
Mātāva dahare putte, gilāne yobbane ṭhite;Sakiccapasute ceva, catudhā sampavattati.
Phullaṃva kamalaṃ kāle, candaṃva vimalaṃ jano;Sommakomaladhammehi, piyacakkhūhi passati.
Avañjhā tassa pabbajjā, yassa hetāsu gāravo;Sukhumodagyabahulo, tisso sikkhā susikkhati.
Saddhādikusalā dhammā, pavaḍḍhanti akhaṇḍitā;Sambuddhicariyānañca, mahattaṃ tassa pākaṭaṃ.
Appameyyānisaṃsevaṃ, appameyyaguṇodayā;Appamaññā tato tāsu, na pamajjeyya paṇḍito.
Asitaṃ khāyitaṃ pītaṃ, sāyitañca rahogato;Paṭikkūlanti cinteyya, gamanādivasā kathaṃ.
Tapovanamidaṃ hitvā, ramaṇīyamanākulaṃ;Āhārahetu gantabbo, gāmo gāmajanākulo.
Tatthāsuciparikliṭṭhe, dujjanāvārasaṅkare;Dīnamesayatuttiṭṭhaṃ, gehe gehe tu bhojanaṃ.
Tattacandanikāyaṃva, nānākimisamākule;Tattha bubbuḷakacchannaṃ, kuthitaṃ paripaccati.
Pūtibhūtañca taṃ pakka-manekadvārasañcitaṃ;Medapiṇḍaṃva kuthitaṃ, parissavati santataṃ.
Tattha cittavirāgāya, kiṃ pakkaphalasannibhe;Rasassādapiyākāre, ghorādīnavasañcite.
Yūsabhūtanti yaṃ kiñci,Āpova paripācakaṃ;Tejo vāyoti gaṇheyya,Vitthambhakamasesato.
Tadetaṃ catukoṭṭhāsaṃ, kāyasambhavamattano;Tejodhātūti gaṇheyya, vāyodhātūticāparaṃ.
Nibbindanto tato rūpe, tadākāre ca gocare;Tadālambaṇadhamme ca, patthento samatikkamaṃ.
Paṭhamāruppaviññāṇa-mabhāvento tato paraṃ;Appeti tatiyāruppa-mākiñcaññamhi gocare.
Gūthamhi maṇḍape laggo, eko tannissitoparo;Eko bahi anissāya, taṃ taṃ nissāya cāparo.
Suppaṇītatarā honti, uddhamuddhaṃ yathākkamaṃ;Cātumahārājikādidibbasampattiyo yathā.
Dukkhā ca dukkhavatthū ca, abhiṇhaparipīḷitā;Rogā gaṇḍā ca sallā ca, aghato ca upaddavā.
Attalābhaṃ gavesanti, taṃtaṃpaccayanissitā;Dukkhādhiṭṭhānamaccantaṃ, jātā puna vihaññare.
Jāyamānā ca jiyyantā, miyyantā ca khaṇe khaṇe;Pasukā viya niccammā, haññanti serikāturā.
Tilāni tilayanteva, ucchuyanteva ucchuyo;Udayabbayāvassaṃ te, pīḷayanti abhiṇhaso.
Saṅkhāresu panetesu, vedanāssādarodhino;Sāva sandulasambaddhā, sammohaparivāritā.
Cavantā upapajjantā, rukkhasākhaṃva makkaṭo;Dukkhamekaṃ vimuccanti, tato gaṇhanti cāparaṃ.
Te dīgharattaṃ socanti, taṇhāsallasamappitā;Diṭṭhipāsasamupetā, mānatthambhānusāyino.
Yathāpaccayalābhena, pavattanti yathā tathā;Rakkhitā vā vidhātā vā, natthi assāmikā tathā.
‘‘Ahaṃ mama’’nti gaṇhantā, pariṇāmenti aññathā;Vissasantā harantete, parābhūtā palambhino.
Jāyamānā ca jiyyantā, miyyamānā ca saṅkhatā;Vivasā parivattanti, vaso tesaṃ na katthaci.
Cetovipphāranipphannā, vāyodhātusamuṭṭhitā;Iriyāpathaviññattivikārā pālakā matā.
Janakā paccayānañhi, tadāyūhanato paraṃ;Parihāritumāraddhā, jiyā khittasaro yathā.
Sithilā jātu nissārā, dubbalā lahughātino;Khayadhammāti saṅkhāya, ghanasaññaṃ vimuñcati.
Iccāvatthāpabhedena, dasadhāpi vibhāvitā;Sabhāgatthavisesena, tidhā saṅgahitā puna.
Sukhumā nipuṇākārā, khuradhārāgatā viya;Gaṇhantī bhāvanāgabbhaṃ, pavaḍḍhati vipassanā.
